instructions.question: Does the poster of this Serbian tweet clearly express a positive feeling (warmth, joy, praise, cheering), a negative feeling (displeasure, sadness, self-put-down, or a sarcastic or mocking jab), or neither (neutral)?
instructions.rule: Choose neutral unless a clear feeling stands out. Jokes, witty observations, absurd or exaggerated anecdotes, banter, aphorisms, opinions, questions and routine announcements (including culture, sport or event news) are neutral. Negative needs explicit displeasure (hate, boredom, pain, tiredness, sadness, cursing a situation), calling oneself stupid, ugly or a failure, or a pointed sarcastic or mocking jab at someone; crime or scandal headlines are negative too. Positive needs clear warmth, joy, praise, cheering, compliments, or explicitly good news such as wins or awards.

neutral.what: Information, routine news and announcements, plans, questions, aphorisms, banter, jokes, witty observations, absurd self-anecdotes and opinions without a clear feeling.
examples: Igram tenis kao @DjokerNole  ali nemam milione da to I dokazem. (I play tennis like Djokovic but don't have millions to prove it.)
RT @ArtBoulevard: 15. Festival studentskog filma poziva zainteresovane (15th Student Film Festival invites those interested)
Gledacu serije. (I'll watch series.)
RT @MakiJaffa: Dobri ljudi ti donose srecu. Losi iskustvo. (Good people bring you luck. Bad ones experience.)
neutral.cues: kao (like), jel (is it), :P, haha in banter, dates, link shares, sayings
neutral.not_for: Explicit displeasure, self-put-downs and mocking jabs are negative. Clear joy or praise is positive.

positive.what: Clear warmth, joy, love, admiration, cheering, greetings, compliments, loud laughter, or explicitly good news (wins, awards, success).
examples: Uskoro drugi deo House of cards, sjajno! (Second season of House of Cards soon, great!)
@pUnaVuna jel ti radis ili rtw-ujes :-) Elem, do jaja si :-) (are you working or retweeting :-) anyway, you're awesome)
Serena Vilijams teniserka godine (Serena Williams tennis player of the year)
positive.cues: sjajno (great), do jaja (awesome), car (king), volim (I love), srećna (happy), ajmo (come on), HAHAHA, pobeda (victory)
positive.not_for: Mock praise is negative. A plain reply with just a smiley, or a routine event announcement, is neutral.

negative.what: Explicit displeasure, boredom, pain, sadness, self-put-downs, sarcastic or mocking jabs at people, politicians or media, and crime or scandal headlines.
examples: Mrzim ponedeljak (I hate Monday)
RT @Johnny94Serbia: Svake godine provalim koliko sam prethodne bio ružan i glup. Ali svake. (Every year I realize how ugly and stupid I was the year before.)
lepo je sto ih kristina savetuje posto je bas uspela u soubizu <3 (nice that Kristina advises them since she really made it in showbiz <3)
negative.cues: mrzim (I hate), najgore (the worst), dosadno (boring), bljak (yuck), jebi ga (damn), glup (stupid), tuga (sadness), :( , ubijen (killed)
negative.not_for: Funny observations and exaggerated mishaps without real complaint are neutral.
